documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility and the transition from a trading-led to a manufacturing-driven model. Management reported strong financial growth for the quarter and the full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and backward integration into textile binders and table glue. The company outlined priorities for FY2027, including scaling manufacturing capacity utilization to 100%, shifting the revenue mix to a 50-50 split between trading and manufacturing, and expanding binder sales into non-textile industries. Furthermore, management noted that internal accruals and strong cash flows are expected to support working capital and debt reduction without significant additional capital expenditure. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year ended FY26, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA can increase by 200 to 300 basis points with complete plant utilization.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: Management targets achieving a 50-50 revenue contribution between manufacturing and trading.
guidance.quote: Right now, . Like it is in trading and manufacturing right now what we did as of now was 75%-25% that will become 50%-50% .

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity of 500 tons per month by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: Management maintains the earlier revenue guidance to close the year around INR 110 crores.
guidance.quote: Prateek Chaudhary: Sir, in our last con call, we had said that this year we would close around INR110 crores. So are you still maintaining that guidance or has something changed? Tushar Sanghavi: No, of course the same.

guidance.claim: At full utilization, the 500-ton manufacturing capacity can generate a total turnover of around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Growth in the textile ink market is expected to be 15% to 20% and 20% to 30% for the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects to selectively expand its market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment, encouraged by improving demand trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance, prompt technical services, and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources, to expand the product portfolio.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has further scope to expand manufacturing capacity by putting up additional vessels costing around INR 3 crore to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production has commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process with a zero-carbon footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process combined with advanced automation and process controls, which ensuring consistent product quality and high throughput and zero carbon footprint.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The proactive inventory strategy helped secure raw materials at favourable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25%, whereas trading business margins are 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: When we compare specifically for, comparison with manufacturing and trading business, we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR 7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in Q3 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew by 117.4% to INR 4.06 crores with the PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax also showed strong growth, rising by 117.4% to INR4.06 crores with PAT margin improving 620 basis points to 12.1%.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices at the plant have not seen significant changes over the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first two months of starting manufacturing, the facility utilized around 60% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the INR 33 crores revenue in Q3, 25% came from manufacturing and 75% from the trading business.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, out of this INR33 crores revenue in Q3, from the manufacturing we are getting 25% and rest of the 75% from the trading business.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is confident that working capital will not become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR 30 crores is a bank loan and INR 20 crores was funded through IPO, internal accruals, and unsecured loans from promoters.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The expected payback period for the INR 40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's net worth stood at around INR 42 crores by December end.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Conference call statements include a reminder that forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainty and actual results may differ.
risks_headwinds.quote: The statements are not guarantees of future performance and involve risks and uncertainty.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months to expand the product portfolio and enter adjacent categories.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch new products within a couple of months following ongoing R&D trials.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: R&D efforts may lead to launching new products within 3 to 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: Since sorry to interrupt, our R&D is also going on, so maybe within 3-4 months we can launch some new products also, so we may expand little bit with the capacity of the vessels also.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions and technical seminars.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Within the next 1 to 2 years, trading and manufacturing revenues are expected to be equal at 50% import and 50% manufactured products.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
